name: onetrust
title: OneTrust
description: Holds Datadog RUM until the visitor accepts OneTrust's analytics category, then reports the accepted categories as session context.

platforms.name: OneTrust Cookie Consent
platforms.notes: Any site running the OneTrust banner script (otSDKStub.js).

install.platform: Google Tag Manager Custom HTML tag

howItWorks.summary: Holds RUM before it starts, then releases it when OneTrust reports that the visitor accepted the required category. It sends no actions of its own.

steps.title: Holds RUM before the SDK starts
steps.detail: In `onInit` it sets `trackingConsent` to not-granted in the init options, so the SDK collects nothing on a page where the banner hasn't been answered. Put it first in `plugins`.

steps.title: Reads the visitor's answer
steps.detail: `window.OnetrustActiveGroups` is the comma-delimited list of accepted categories that OneTrust's banner script sets, e.g. `,C0001,C0002,`. The plugin reads it at init, in case the visitor answered on an earlier page.

steps.title: Listens on every signal OneTrust sends
steps.detail: It listens for `OneTrustGroupsUpdated` on the window, wraps `window.OptanonWrapper` (chaining the page's own wrapper, if any), and once the banner script has loaded registers `Optanon.OnConsentChanged` on `window.Optanon`. Each one re-reads the active groups, so any one of them firing is enough.

steps.title: Grants, or withdraws
steps.detail: When the required category (C0002 by default) is active it calls `setTrackingConsent('granted')`, and `'not-granted'` if the visitor later turns it off. The accepted categories go to session context as `consent.categories` through `setGlobalContextProperty`.

steps.title: Fails closed
steps.detail: If OneTrust never reports within the timeout, RUM stays held and a warning is logged. A `pagehide` listener clears the timer.

options.name: category
options.description: OneTrust category that must be active before RUM may collect. Accepts an array for sites that require several.

options.name: reportCategories
options.description: Send the accepted categories as the consent.categories global context property.

options.name: timeoutMs
options.description: How long to wait for the banner script before warning. RUM stays held either way.

options.name: debug
options.description: Log consent transitions to the console.
